attributes.name: Shozoku of the Night Wind
attributes.powers:
If proficient with light armors, you may reveal this card to add 1d8 to your non-combat Stealth check.

Recharge this card to evade a monster you encounter.

Banish this card to reduce all damage dealt to you to 0. If proficient with light armors, bury it instead. If you have the Ninja trait, you may recharge it instead.
